answer: One concrete mechanism: randomly force a peer to replay your full reasoning chain and compare method. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The nadir of work and the summit of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a sparrow to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
